q.en: Turn into passive: "The company produces 500 cars a day."
q.bn: Passive-এ রূপান্তর করো: "The company produces 500 cars a day."

options.en: 500 cars produces a day by the company.
options.bn: 500 cars produces a day by the company.

options.en: 500 cars are produced a day by the company.
options.bn: 500 cars are produced a day by the company.

options.en: 500 cars is produced a day by the company.
options.bn: 500 cars is produced a day by the company.

options.en: 500 cars are producing a day by the company.
options.bn: 500 cars are producing a day by the company.

why.en: The object (500 cars) becomes the subject, and the verb becomes "are produced" — plural "be" plus past participle.
why.bn: Object (500 cars) subject হয়ে যায়, verb হয় "are produced" — plural "be" plus past participle।

q.bn: ঠিক করো: "The letter was wrote yesterday."

options.en: The letter was written yesterday.
The letter wrote yesterday.
The letter was write yesterday.
The letter is wrote yesterday.

why.en: The passive always needs the past participle ("written"), never the past simple form ("wrote").
why.bn: Passive-এ সবসময় past participle লাগে ("written"), past simple form ("wrote") লাগে না।

q.en: Which sounds more objective/academic for an essay?
q.bn: Essay-এর জন্য কোনটা বেশি objective/academic শোনায়?

options.en: I think pollution is a serious problem.
options.bn: I think pollution is a serious problem.

options.en: Pollution is widely considered a serious problem.
options.bn: Pollution is widely considered a serious problem.

options.en: Pollution, I believe, is a serious problem.
options.bn: Pollution, I believe, is a serious problem.

options.en: Everyone I know thinks pollution is a serious problem.
options.bn: Everyone I know thinks pollution is a serious problem.

why.en: The passive removes the personal "I think" and presents the idea as general knowledge, which is more academic.
why.bn: Passive personal "I think" বাদ দিয়ে idea-কে general knowledge-এর মতো দেখায়, যেটা বেশি academic।

options.en: The bridge built in 2005.
The bridge was built in 2005.
The bridge is build in 2005.
The bridge was build in 2005.

why.en: The passive needs "was/were" + past participle together — the past participle alone is not enough.
why.bn: Passive-এ "was/were" + past participle একসাথে লাগে — past participle একা যথেষ্ট না।

q.en: Why can't "He arrived" become passive ("was arrived")?
q.bn: "He arrived" কেন passive হতে পারে না ("was arrived")?

options.en: Because "arrive" is in the past tense.
Because "arrive" has no object — it's intransitive.
options.bn: কারণ "arrive"-এর কোনো object নেই — এটা intransitive।

options.en: Because "he" is a pronoun, not a noun.
Because the sentence is too short.

why.en: Only transitive verbs (verbs with an object) can be made passive. "Arrive" has no object, so it has no passive form.
why.bn: শুধু transitive verb (যার object আছে) passive হতে পারে। "Arrive"-এর কোনো object নেই, তাই এর passive form নেই।
